question: A hemispherical tank has an inner diameter of 1.4 m. Find its capacity. (Take π = 22/7) (Rounded up to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given the tank diameter is 1.4 m, its radius r = 0.7 m.

Volume of a hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³.

Volume = (2/3) × (22/7) × (0.7)³

Volume = 2.156 ÷ 3 ≈ 0.7186 m³

Rounding up to two decimal places, we get 0.72 m³.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.72 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Inner diameter of the hemispherical tank (d) = 1.4 m

Radius (r) = d ÷ 2 = 1.4 ÷ 2 = 0.7 m

**Formula Used:**

Capacity
